sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上免费直播部分精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: In Bucks County, Pennsylvania...
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州的巴克斯县……

sentences.en: We would like school reopened on time with as few safety measures as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们希望学校能按时重新开放，并尽可能减少安全措施。

sentences.en: What started as a group of frustrated parents organizing to push the district to reopen schools
sentences.zh: 最初，一群心怀不满的家长组织起来推动学区重开学校，

sentences.en: devolved over the course of a year and a half into partisan fighting over the country's most divisive cultural issues.
sentences.zh: 但在一年半的时间里，演变成了围绕该国最具争议的文化议题的党派斗争。

sentences.en: The treatment of our children during this pandemic has been an eye-opening to deception and lies perpetrated by the people in this room.
sentences.zh: 在这场疫情期间，我们孩子所受的对待，让我们看清了这间屋子里的人所犯下的欺骗和谎言。

sentences.en: Yesterday on The Daily...
sentences.zh: 昨天的《每日新闻》节目中……

sentences.en: COVID has broken you people, and it's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情已经击垮了你们这些人，这真令人作呕。

sentences.en: My colleague Campbell Robertson traced the history of that battle in Bucks County...
sentences.zh: 我的同事坎贝尔·罗伯逊梳理了巴克斯县那场斗争的历史……

sentences.en: I watch how you treat each other in here.
sentences.zh: 我看着你们在这里是如何对待彼此的。

sentences.en: It's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 这真令人作呕。

sentences.en: ...culminating with the resignation of the school board's only swing vote.
sentences.zh: ……最终以校董会唯一摇摆票的辞职而告终。

sentences.en: Common decency.
sentences.zh: 基本的体面。

sentences.en: You'll need to find it real faSt.
sentences.zh: 你们得尽快找回它。

sentences.en: Today, in Part 2, as the school board elections near,
sentences.zh: 今天，在第二部分，随着校董会选举临近，

sentences.en: What is actually happening inside the schools in Bucks?
sentences.zh: 巴克斯县的学校里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: And where is all of this headed?
sentences.zh: 这一切又将走向何方？

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, November 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月17日，星期三。

sentences.en: Okay, Campbell, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 好的，坎贝尔，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Good to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回来。

sentences.en: When we left off last,
sentences.zh: 上次我们说到，

sentences.en: John Gamble, the school board's most moderate figure, had just resigned out of frustration with how ugly things had gotten in Bucks County.
sentences.zh: 校董会中最温和的人物约翰·甘布尔，因为对巴克斯县局势变得如此恶劣感到沮丧而刚刚辞职。

sentences.en: And he used this metaphor with you to describe what the school board and parents were focused on when it came to problems facing the district.
sentences.zh: 他用了一个比喻来向你描述校董会和家长们在面对学区问题时关注的重点。

sentences.en: He said it's like arguing over putting new tires on a car but forgetting to put any gas in it.
sentences.zh: 他说这就像是在争论给车换新轮胎，却忘了给车加油。

sentences.en: And what he seemed to mean was, you all are fighting about all this stuff, but you're ignoring the essentials.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是，你们都在为这些琐事争吵，却忽略了本质问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's, I don't know if you want to say funny, maybe it's embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不知道该说这很有趣，还是令人尴尬。

sentences.en: You know, you realize with all the talk and attention there is right now on schools, how little the actual day-to-day situation inside the schools is coming up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你意识到现在所有关于学校的讨论和关注，却很少涉及学校内部实际的日常状况时，你会感到震惊。

sentences.en: It's like, oh yeah, school, education, what's going on there?
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，对了，学校，教育，那里到底在发生什么？

sentences.en: And what do you find in Central Bucks?
sentences.zh: 你在中央巴克斯学区发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, everyone's back in the building.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大家都回到了学校。

sentences.en: The schools opened this year full-time in person when students came back end of August, early September.
sentences.zh: 学校在今年8月底、9月初学生返校时就已全面恢复线下授课。

sentences.en: But among the people working in the schools, morale appears to be pretty low.
sentences.zh: 但在学校工作的人员中，士气似乎相当低落。

sentences.en: I mean, in a lot of ways, this isn't surprising, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在很多方面，这并不令人惊讶，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, all over the country, we're in year two of COVID.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，全国各地都处于新冠疫情的第二年。

sentences.en: Schools have borne the brunt of a lot of this.
sentences.zh: 学校承担了大部分压力。

sentences.en: They've been having to balance health risks with taking care and educating children.
sentences.zh: 他们必须在健康风险与照顾和教育孩子之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: This is really, really hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: But it did seem like people were surprised that it had gotten this bad in Central Bucks because historically, the district had been really well-resourced, really well-functioning.
sentences.zh: 但人们似乎确实对中央巴克斯学区的情况恶化到这种程度感到惊讶，因为从历史上看，该学区资源非常丰富，运作也非常良好。

sentences.en: It was a place where teachers really wanted to work.
sentences.zh: 那是一个老师们非常向往工作的地方。

sentences.en: So I started reaching out to nurses, custodians, teachers, education assistants, staff all over the district to just ask, what school is like these days?
sentences.zh: 所以我开始联系护士、保管员、教师、教育助理，以及学区各处的员工，只是想问问，现在的学校生活是什么样的？

sentences.en: And I found a lot of people who were eager to talk with me about what was happening.
sentences.zh: 我发现很多人都渴望与我谈论正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: But very few of them wanted to go on the record.
sentences.zh: 但很少有人愿意公开记录。

sentences.en: I mean, they're seeing what's happening at the meetings.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们看到了会议上发生的一切。

sentences.en: They're seeing how polarized the board's gotten.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了董事会变得多么两极分化。

sentences.en: They know the political atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 他们了解政治氛围。

sentences.en: They're scared for their jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们担心自己的工作。

sentences.en: And they don't want to get dragged into all this.
sentences.zh: 他们不想被卷入这一切。

sentences.en: But there was a feeling that this was something they really wanted people to hear about and understand.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实觉得，这是他们非常希望人们能听到并理解的事情。

sentences.en: Hey, Betsy, we've talked.
sentences.zh: 嘿，贝琪，我们聊过了。

sentences.en: We haven't seen each other.
sentences.zh: 我们还没见过面。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: So Betsy Coyne teaches family and consumer sciences at one of the secondary schools in Central Bucks.
sentences.zh: 贝琪·科恩在中央巴克斯的一所中学教授家庭与消费者科学。

sentences.en: And she's been working in the district for almost 20 years.
sentences.zh: 她在该学区工作了近20年。

sentences.en: When you first got the offer that you were accepted of a position at Central Bucks, what was going through your head?
sentences.zh: 当你第一次收到中央巴克斯学区的录用通知时，你当时在想什么？

sentences.en: I thought I had won the jackpot.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我中了头奖。

sentences.en: I had secured an amazing job.
sentences.zh: 我得到了一份令人惊叹的工作。

sentences.en: CB teachers were the best of the beSt.
sentences.zh: 中央巴克斯的老师是精英中的精英。

sentences.en: And they were exceptional.
sentences.zh: 他们非常出色。

sentences.en: It was like winning the lottery to have a job in Central Bucks.
sentences.zh: 能在中央巴克斯工作就像中了彩票一样。

sentences.en: And I thought that teaching was like my destiny.
sentences.zh: 我觉得教书就是我的宿命。

sentences.en: And you felt that for a long time, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来你很长一段时间都是这么认为的。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I was exactly where I was meant to be.
sentences.zh: 我正处于我该在的地方。

sentences.en: And then the pandemic hit.
sentences.zh: 然后疫情爆发了。

sentences.en: And you felt like you could never be successful.
sentences.zh: 你觉得你永远无法成功。

sentences.en: And it was defeating.
sentences.zh: 这让人感到挫败。

sentences.en: There was the whiplash, all this back and forth from virtual to hybrid to full in-person,
sentences.zh: 那种剧烈的动荡，在虚拟、混合和全面线下授课之间来回切换，

sentences.en: which left so many teachers feeling like they weren't doing their jobs as well as they wanted to.
sentences.zh: 让许多老师觉得他们没能像自己期望的那样做好本职工作。

sentences.en: And that was compounded by so many other teachers deciding their hearts were no longer in it at all.
sentences.zh: 再加上许多其他老师决定不再全心投入，情况就更糟了。

sentences.en: And this is pretty much at the core of what schools in Central Bucks and really schools all over the country are dealing with.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是中央巴克斯乃至全国学校所面临问题的核心。

sentences.en: Major staffing shortages.
sentences.zh: 严重的人员短缺。

sentences.en: My co-worker went out on maternity leave.
sentences.zh: 我的同事去休产假了。

sentences.en: The baby came a week early.
sentences.zh: 孩子提前一周出生了。

sentences.en: And not one certified family consumer science teacher applied for the job.
sentences.zh: 结果没有一位获得认证的家庭消费者科学老师申请这个职位。

sentences.en: Not one.
sentences.zh: 一个都没有。

sentences.en: So what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 那你怎么办？

sentences.en: The school hired a building sub.
sentences.zh: 学校雇了一名校内代课老师。

sentences.en: And I had a brand new building sub come in.
sentences.zh: 我迎来了一位全新的校内代课老师。

sentences.en: And a building sub, by the way, might not necessarily be certified in the stuff you're teaching, right?
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，校内代课老师未必拥有你所教科目的认证，对吧？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They are covering classes and helping out where needed.
sentences.zh: 他们负责代课并在需要时提供帮助。

sentences.en: So they hired a building sub to fill her position.
sentences.zh: 所以他们雇了一名校内代课老师来填补她的空缺。

sentences.en: And for the first month of school, I was not only writing lesson plans and planning lessons for my classes,
sentences.zh: 开学第一个月，我不仅要为自己的课程编写教案和规划课程，

sentences.en: but I was planning lessons and teaching him how to teach FCS classes so that he could teach her classes.
sentences.zh: 还要规划课程并教他如何教授家庭消费者科学课程，这样他才能教她的课。

sentences.en: A lot of the other staff I talked to describe their own versions of this story.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的许多其他员工都描述了他们自己经历的类似故事。

sentences.en: They laid out a series of problems that, in their minds, are the kinds of issues that everybody concerned with schools in Central Bucks should be focused on.
sentences.zh: 他们列出了一系列问题，在他们看来，这些都是每个关心中央巴克斯学校的人都应该关注的问题。

sentences.en: So, for instance, the school staff, right?
sentences.zh: 比如，学校员工，对吧？

sentences.en: The custodians, some of the nurses, the educational assistants, personal care assistants, they're working without a labor contract.
sentences.zh: 保管员、一些护士、教育助理、个人护理助理，他们是在没有劳动合同的情况下工作的。

sentences.en: They're negotiating it, but they haven't reached a deal.
sentences.zh: 他们正在协商，但尚未达成协议。

sentences.en: So that's been a big source of stress for those workers who were there the whole time last year during COVID.
sentences.zh: 这对去年整个新冠疫情期间都在岗的员工来说，是一个巨大的压力来源。

sentences.en: And all of these workers described feeling overstretched and basically at a breaking point because, of course,
sentences.zh: 所有这些员工都描述说感到过度劳累，基本上到了崩溃的边缘，因为当然，

sentences.en: the pandemic has triggered a lot of behavioral problems in the classroom, which are bumping into the staff shortages, which is a rough combination.
sentences.zh: 疫情引发了课堂上许多行为问题，这些问题与人员短缺叠加在一起，是一个糟糕的组合。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you have education assistants.
sentences.zh: 所以你有教育助理。

sentences.en: They're in the classrooms to help students who need special attention, you know, to deal with these students when the teacher's trying to teach the class.
sentences.zh: 他们在课堂上帮助需要特别关注的学生，你知道，当老师试图授课时，他们负责处理这些学生的问题。

sentences.en: But they're being shuffled around to fill in the gaps created by staffing shortages.
sentences.zh: 但他们被调来调去，以填补人员短缺造成的空缺。

sentences.en: And so those students just disrupt the class to get the attention they need.
sentences.zh: 于是那些学生为了得到他们需要的关注，就会扰乱课堂。

sentences.en: Then there are these broader behavioral issues.
sentences.zh: 此外还有更广泛的行为问题。

sentences.en: So nationally, there's this TikTok challenge where kids are filming themselves going into bathrooms, just committing crazy acts of vandalism, you know, breaking soap dispensers,
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，有一个 TikTok 挑战，孩子们拍摄自己进入洗手间，进行疯狂的破坏行为，你知道，破坏肥皂分配器，

sentences.en: breaking sinks, going to the bathroom all over the floor.
sentences.zh: 破坏水槽，把厕所弄得满地都是。

sentences.en: Right now, we have already caught.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们已经抓到了。

sentences.en: In Central Bucks, it got so bad they had to shut down all but one bathroom in some of the schools.
sentences.zh: 在中央巴克斯，情况变得如此糟糕，以至于他们不得不关闭了一些学校里除一个以外的所有洗手间。

sentences.en: And students just had to wait in line.
sentences.zh: 学生们只能排队等候。

sentences.en: And somebody from the school staff would sit at a desk and let the students in one by one.
sentences.zh: 学校工作人员会坐在桌子旁，让学生一个接一个地进去。

sentences.en: And obviously, all this trashing of the bathrooms was something that the custodians had to deal with.
sentences.zh: 显然，所有这些对洗手间的破坏都是保管员必须处理的事情。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, and everybody is just having to do much, much more work.
sentences.zh: 是的，每个人都不得不做更多、更多的工作。

sentences.en: I mean, for example, just look at nurses.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，例如，看看护士们。

sentences.en: So remember how as the school year was getting started,
sentences.zh: 还记得学年刚开始时吗？

sentences.en: the board narrowly passed a version of a mask requirement that made it pretty easy for parents who oppose masks to file for an exemption.
sentences.zh: 董事会以微弱优势通过了一个口罩要求版本，这使得反对口罩的家长很容易申请豁免。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These are the waiver request forms that give parents, as you told us, Campbell,
sentences.zh: 这些就是豁免申请表，正如你告诉我们的，坎贝尔，

sentences.en: the option to request that their kids not wear masks based on the idea that masks might make their children's mental health worse,
sentences.zh: 让家长可以选择申请让他们的孩子不戴口罩，理由是口罩可能会使他们孩子的心理健康恶化，

sentences.en: which it turns out is exactly what many anti-mask people think is wrong with masks.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这正是许多反口罩人士认为口罩的问题所在。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what happens is, after that version of the mask mandate passes, parents apply for something like 1,500 mask exemptions for their kids.
sentences.zh: 所以发生的事情是，在那个版本的口罩强制令通过后，家长们为他们的孩子申请了大约1500份口罩豁免。

sentences.en: That's around 8% of the student population.
sentences.zh: 这大约占学生总数的8%。

sentences.en: And from what I can tell, they're pretty much always granted.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这些申请几乎总是被批准的。

sentences.en: But they require paperwork, and the nurses typically have to process a lot of that paperwork for hundreds of waivers.
sentences.zh: 但它们需要文书工作，护士通常必须处理数百份豁免申请中的大部分文书工作。

sentences.en: And at the same time, they're doing contract tracing for COVID outbreaks that are actually breaking out in the schools.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们还要为学校里实际爆发的新冠疫情进行接触者追踪。

sentences.en: Last month, there were more than two dozen kids at one elementary school in the district who tested positive.
sentences.zh: 上个月，该学区一所小学有超过两打的孩子检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: And there was a big back and forth about it.
sentences.zh: 关于这件事，双方进行了激烈的争论。

sentences.en: You know, there were some parents of kids at the school who said, this is exactly what's wrong with the district's COVID plan, with the mask exemptions, all that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，学校里有一些孩子的家长说，这正是学区新冠计划、口罩豁免等所有问题所在。

sentences.en: But the anti-mask mandate parents came out and said, this outbreak is being overblown to justify more COVID restrictions.
sentences.zh: 但反对口罩强制令的家长出来说，这次疫情被夸大了，目的是为了证明更多的防疫限制是合理的。

sentences.en: And so while that back and forth is going on, the school nurses still have to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 所以当这种争论持续时，校医仍然必须处理这些问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in some schools, nurses have been so busy with this kind of thing that they've had to limit student visits in certain hours to emergencies only.
sentences.zh: 在一些学校，护士们忙于处理这类事情，以至于不得不限制学生在特定时间段的就诊，仅限紧急情况。

sentences.en: So like, a kid who just doesn't feel great might have to wait.
sentences.zh: 所以，一个感觉不太舒服的孩子可能不得不等待。

sentences.en: I mean, being short staff affects everyone.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人手不足会影响每个人。

sentences.en: It affects students, it affects teachers, it affects the principals, it affects every person that walks into that building that day.
sentences.zh: 它影响学生，影响老师，影响校长，影响那天走进那栋楼的每一个人。

sentences.en: So what's it like in your classroom right now, this year?
sentences.zh: 那么今年你现在的课堂是什么样的？

sentences.en: This year has been difficult.
sentences.zh: 今年很困难。

sentences.en: I would see that I'm seeing significant delays.
sentences.zh: 我会说我看到了明显的滞后。

sentences.en: Students are behind.
sentences.zh: 学生们落后了。

sentences.en: They are a year and a half behind socially and emotionally.
sentences.zh: 他们在社交和情感上落后了一年半。

sentences.en: And I can give a great example that I teach students how to cook.
sentences.zh: 我可以举一个很好的例子，我教学生如何做饭。

sentences.en: And I teach cooking labs.
sentences.zh: 我教烹饪实验课。

sentences.en: And the first time we did a lab, we had gone through all of our prep work.
sentences.zh: 我们第一次做实验时，我们已经完成了所有的准备工作。

sentences.en: We had jobs assigned.
sentences.zh: 我们之前分配过工作。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, I look around and everybody's just standing in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我环顾四周，发现每个人都只是站在教室里。

sentences.en: And they don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道该做什么。

sentences.en: And that moment that I looked around and I saw all of the students just standing there.
sentences.zh: 就在我环顾四周，看到所有学生都站在那里的那一刻。

sentences.en: I think what truly hit me was, this is real.
sentences.zh: 我想真正触动我的是，这一切都是真实的。

sentences.en: These delays, the social, emotional, the not knowing how to do cooperative work, how to work with others, all of those things became real in that moment.
sentences.zh: 这些延误，社交、情感上的问题，不知道如何进行合作，不知道如何与他人共事，所有这些在那个瞬间都变得真实起来。

sentences.en: They don't know how to work together as a group.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道如何作为一个团队共同工作。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, I realized that what I had seen or heard or when we talk about, you know, students and what gaps are they going to have,
sentences.zh: 突然间，我意识到我之前所见、所闻，或者当我们谈论学生会有什么差距时，

sentences.en: it was happening to me in my classroom.
sentences.zh: 这一切正在我的教室里发生。

sentences.en: But what I'm most concerned about is what I am hearing being discussed at the school board meetings isn't ways to help us solve our school probleMs.
sentences.zh: 但我最担心的是，我在校董会会议上听到的讨论，并不是在帮我们解决学校的问题。

sentences.en: So you've listened to some of these meetings, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以你至少听过其中一些会议。

sentences.en: I have listened to some of the meetings.
sentences.zh: 我听过一些会议。

sentences.en: I have followed some of the public comments.
sentences.zh: 我关注过一些公众评论。

sentences.en: They were really defeating as an educator to watch.
sentences.zh: 作为一名教育工作者，看到这些真的很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: I got to the point where I would become so upset, I would end up with migraines for two days.
sentences.zh: 我一度感到非常难过，甚至导致偏头痛发作了两天。

sentences.en: And you're saying that what you hear being discussed at these meetings is not what your understanding of what their urgent needs are in a lot of cases.
sentences.zh: 你是说，你在这些会议上听到的讨论，在很多情况下，并不是你所理解的他们的迫切需求。

sentences.en: I mean, what's going on at the school board when we're fighting about politics and theory, like none of that has a place in my classroom.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我们在校董会上争论政治和理论时，这些东西在我的教室里根本没有立足之地。

sentences.en: And my biggest fear is that this is our new normal, that we're not going to have teachers, that we're not going to have staff,
sentences.zh: 我最大的恐惧是，这就是我们的新常态，我们将没有老师，没有教职员工，

sentences.en: that our school board meetings are not helping what's going on in our classrooMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的校董会会议对我们教室里发生的事情毫无帮助。

sentences.en: And that this is just how it's going to be.
sentences.zh: 而且这就是未来的样子了。

sentences.en: And this is how it's going to be, our new normal.
sentences.zh: 这就是未来的样子，我们的新常态。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档关于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在夜店用黑胶唱片打碟的年代，每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: Subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today, and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载时报APP，即可获得30天免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Campbell, Betsy's concern is that the school board meetings are not paying attention to her new normal, the day-to-day problems of educating during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 坎贝尔，贝齐担心的是，校董会会议没有关注她的新常态，即疫情期间教学的日常问题。

sentences.en: And so as the school board elections near, I'm curious if there's any attention being paid to those issues,
sentences.zh: 随着校董会选举临近，我很好奇是否有人关注这些问题，

sentences.en: or is the election being waged along the same battle lines as we've been seeing in the school board meetings, which is to say polarizing social issues dominating?
sentences.zh: 还是说选举正沿着我们在校董会会议上看到的战线进行，也就是极化社会议题占据主导地位？

sentences.en: I mean, the technical answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，技术上的回答是肯定的。

sentences.en: There is some talk about these other issues.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些关于这些其他议题的讨论。

sentences.en: If you went to some of the candidate pages, certainly some candidates more than others, you'll find things like support for the district's overstretched staff,
sentences.zh: 如果你去看看一些候选人的页面，当然有些候选人比其他人更关注，你会发现诸如支持学区超负荷工作的员工，

sentences.en: things they would do about mental health prograMs.
sentences.zh: 以及他们将如何处理心理健康项目等内容。

sentences.en: But in so much of the campaigning and the flyers and the attack ads, the issue at stake in the election is clear.
sentences.zh: 但在大量的竞选活动、传单和攻击性广告中，选举的核心议题很明确。

sentences.en: Parental authority over what goes on in schools, above all when it comes to masks and curriculum.
sentences.zh: 家长对学校事务的权威，尤其是涉及口罩和课程设置时。

sentences.en: And are those materials focusing on these other issues?
sentences.zh: 那么这些材料是否关注了其他议题？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: That's kind of John Gamble's whole point.
sentences.zh: 这正是约翰·甘布尔的全部观点。

sentences.en: As the school board fights have been heating up,
sentences.zh: 随着校董会斗争的升温，

sentences.en: there's very much a sense that control of the board means control over the future of these more divisive issues that the board and parents have been fighting over for the past year or so.
sentences.zh: 人们强烈感觉到，控制校董会就意味着控制这些过去一年左右校董会和家长们争论不休的分裂性议题的未来。

sentences.en: Control over COVID policies.
sentences.zh: 对新冠政策的控制。

sentences.en: Control over school curriculum.
sentences.zh: 对学校课程的控制。

sentences.en: And remember, at this point, the board is basically split, right?
sentences.zh: 记住，目前校董会基本上是分裂的，对吧？

sentences.en: They keep having all of these five to four decisions.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在进行这些五比四的投票决策。

sentences.en: And with five of the nine seats up for election this year, that means control of the board.
sentences.zh: 今年九个席位中有五个要改选，这意味着对校董会的控制权之争。

sentences.en: So everyone involved in these battles is feeling like there's a lot riding on the outcome.
sentences.zh: 所以所有参与这些斗争的人都觉得结果至关重要。

sentences.en: And it would seem that there is in this environment.
sentences.zh: 在这种环境下，似乎确实如此。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So there's way more attention on these races than ever before.
sentences.zh: 所以这些竞选受到的关注比以往任何时候都要多。

sentences.en: And what we start to see around this time in this year's school board campaign is something very new for local school board races,
sentences.zh: 我们在今年校董会竞选的这个阶段开始看到一些对地方校董会选举来说非常新鲜的事情，

sentences.en: which is huge injections of personal cash into the races.
sentences.zh: 那就是向竞选中注入巨额个人资金。

sentences.en: Actually, one person in particular.
sentences.zh: 实际上，主要是某一个人。

sentences.en: Are we all good?
sentences.zh: 我们都准备好了吗？

sentences.en: We're all good.
sentences.zh: 都好了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We're going to give it a go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Paul Martino.
sentences.zh: 保罗·马蒂诺。

sentences.en: And who is Paul Martino?
sentences.zh: 保罗·马蒂诺是谁？

sentences.en: Paul Martino is a venture capitaliSt.
sentences.zh: 保罗·马蒂诺是一位风险投资家。

sentences.en: He's known in part for investing big time in sports betting.
sentences.zh: 他因在体育博彩领域的大手笔投资而闻名。

sentences.en: And he's also a self-described hardcore Republican.
sentences.zh: 他也是一位自称的铁杆共和党人。

sentences.en: His past political spending is reflective of that.
sentences.zh: 他过去的政治捐款反映了这一点。

sentences.en: He's given money to GOP candidates.
sentences.zh: 他曾向共和党候选人捐款。

sentences.en: He's given money to Project Veritas.
sentences.zh: 他曾向“真相工程”捐款。

sentences.en: He actually described himself as a mentor figure to its founder, James O'Keefe.
sentences.zh: 他甚至称自己是该组织创始人詹姆斯·奥基夫的导师。

sentences.en: Who is a very provocative figure in the right-wing media world.
sentences.zh: 那可是右翼媒体界一个非常有争议的人物。

sentences.en: Oh, sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: But what's fascinating about him is that he kind of bridges these two worlds, big money national politics and Central Bucks schools,
sentences.zh: 但他最引人入胜的地方在于，他连接了这两个世界：大额资金的全国政治和中央巴克斯学区，

sentences.en: because he's also a parent with two kids in the district.
sentences.zh: 因为他也是该学区两个孩子的家长。

sentences.en: And of the past few months, that's where he started to put his focus.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几个月里，他开始把精力集中在这里。

sentences.en: Thanks for doing this.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你接受采访。

sentences.en: So I was in Central Bucks last week.
sentences.zh: 我上周去了中央巴克斯。

sentences.en: Obviously, elections are gearing up there and was interested in just the whole dynamics.
sentences.zh: 显然，那里的选举正在升温，我对整个动态很感兴趣。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty unprecedented campaign, the movement that y'all were doing there and wanted to get a sense of what's behind it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你们在那里发起的运动是一场前所未有的竞选，我想了解其背后的动因。

sentences.en: So you're a venture capitaliSt.
sentences.zh: 所以你是一位风险投资家。

sentences.en: You have been politically involved in the past donating money to national figures and national issues.
sentences.zh: 你过去曾参与政治，向全国性人物和全国性议题捐款。

sentences.en: Why are you doing this in local school board races now?
sentences.zh: 为什么现在要参与地方校董会选举？

sentences.en: The prior experience in national donating, I think, is largely red herring to this, meaning that, yes, I've been involved in national causes in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为之前在全国范围内的捐款经历与此基本无关，意思是，是的，我过去参与过全国性的事业。

sentences.en: But my involvement here at the school board level was just a pissed off parent.
sentences.zh: 但我在这里参与校董会事务，仅仅是因为我是一个愤怒的家长。

sentences.en: I mean, we're not afraid to admit that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们不避讳承认这一点。

sentences.en: We just thought our local school boards and administrators dropped the ball getting our kids back to school.
sentences.zh: 我们只是认为我们的地方校董会和行政人员在让孩子返校这件事上失职了。

sentences.en: And there was something that we needed to do about it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要为此做点什么。

sentences.en: So by Martino's account, this didn't start as the latest political opportunity.
sentences.zh: 所以按照马蒂诺的说法，这并不是从最新的政治机会开始的。

sentences.en: It started with him being incredibly frustrated with the administration at his kids' school.
sentences.zh: 它始于他对孩子学校行政部门的极度失望。

sentences.en: And so it became clear that by applying political pressure to the school administrators and to the school board members, that they couldn't hide and go, oh, this is scary.
sentences.zh: 很明显，通过对学校行政人员和校董会成员施加政治压力，他们就无法躲避，无法说‘哦，这太可怕了’，

sentences.en: Oh, I don't know how to open the schools.
sentences.zh: ‘哦，我不知道该怎么开放学校’。

sentences.en: And once we did that and saw that it worked and we got Central Bucks open in just a couple weeks where other school stays closed the entire calendar year,
sentences.zh: 一旦我们这样做了，看到它奏效了，我们在短短几周内就让中央巴克斯学区开放了，而其他学校整个日历年都处于关闭状态，

sentences.en: we said, wow, let's go teach some other people across the state how to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们说，哇，让我们去教教全州其他地方的人怎么做吧。

sentences.en: So in July of this year, he starts a PAC.
sentences.zh: 所以今年七月，他成立了一个政治行动委员会（PAC）。

sentences.en: He calls it Back to School PA.
sentences.zh: 他称之为“回到学校宾夕法尼亚”。

sentences.en: He calls it a single-issue PAC.
sentences.zh: 他称这是一个单一议题的政治行动委员会。

sentences.en: And that single issue is keeping schools open.
sentences.zh: 而那个单一议题就是保持学校开放。

sentences.en: And how it works is his PAC gives money to other PACs at the district level.
sentences.zh: 它的运作方式是，他的委员会向学区层面的其他委员会提供资金。

sentences.en: And he tells those other PACs, I want this money to go to school board candidates who will support my issue and keep the schools open.
sentences.zh: 他告诉那些委员会，我希望这些钱流向支持我议题并保持学校开放的校董会候选人。

sentences.en: And then those PACs are supposed to donate to candidates who will do just that.
sentences.zh: 然后那些委员会应该向能够做到这一点的候选人捐款。

sentences.en: So this PAC, Back to School PA, starts giving out money all over the state, around the Philly suburbs, around Pittsburgh, all these places in between.
sentences.zh: 所以这个“回到学校宾夕法尼亚”委员会开始在全州范围内发放资金，在费城郊区、匹兹堡周围以及所有这些地方之间。

sentences.en: And by October, it's given out around $700,000 statewide.
sentences.zh: 到十月份，它已经在全州发放了大约70万美元。

sentences.en: Wow, that's real money.
sentences.zh: 哇，那是真金白银。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing that is a lot more money than we're used to seeing in local school board campaigns.
sentences.zh: 我猜这比我们习惯在地方校董会竞选中看到的资金要多得多。

sentences.en: It's a lot of money, but what may be most new and noteworthy is that so much of the money sloshing around in these races is coming from one guy.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一大笔钱，但最值得注意的新现象是，这些竞选中流动的资金大部分来自同一个人。

sentences.en: Typically, a lot of the money in school board races comes from small donors.
sentences.zh: 通常，校董会竞选中的大部分资金来自小额捐赠者。

sentences.en: So, you know, the local party will give some money, the teachers' union sometimes.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，地方政党会给一些钱，教师工会有时也会给。

sentences.en: Well, this year in Bucks County, just one local PAC had put $50,000 into the races in the county by mid-October.
sentences.zh: 嗯，今年在巴克斯县，仅一个地方委员会到十月中旬就向县里的竞选投入了5万美元。

sentences.en: And almost all of that came from Martino.
sentences.zh: 而几乎所有这些钱都来自马蒂诺。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In another district, in the Philly suburbs that I looked at, Martino donates $10,000 to the local PAC, supporting his candidates.
sentences.zh: 在费城郊区的另一个我调查过的学区，马蒂诺向支持他候选人的地方委员会捐赠了1万美元。

sentences.en: The total sum that PAC raised was something like $10,420.
sentences.zh: 该委员会筹集的总额大约是10420美元。

sentences.en: So in some cases, Martino is essentially the sole funder of the PAC.
sentences.zh: 所以在某些情况下，马蒂诺本质上是该委员会的唯一资助者。

sentences.en: As of mid-October, yeah, that seemed to be true.
sentences.zh: 截至十月中旬，是的，这似乎是真的。

sentences.en: And in that one donation he made in the district I was just talking about, in one fell swoop,
sentences.zh: 在他刚才提到的那个学区里，他那一次捐款，

sentences.en: he doubled what the opposing candidates raised altogether with mostly smaller donations.
sentences.zh: 就超过了对手候选人通过小额捐款筹集的总和。

sentences.en: So all told, Martino puts half a million dollars of his own money into that $700,000 pool of money that his PAC gives out.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，马蒂诺将他自己50万美元的资金投入到了他委员会发放的70万美元资金池中。

sentences.en: So it totally remakes a lot of these local elections, where in the past, very little money might have been spent by any candidates.
sentences.zh: 这彻底重塑了许多地方选举，而在过去，候选人可能几乎不花什么钱。

sentences.en: Now, for these suburban school board races, you have professional campaign flyers, negative mailers, these sleek attack ad websites.
sentences.zh: 现在，对于这些郊区校董会竞选，你有专业的竞选传单、负面邮件、这些精美的攻击性广告网站。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The best local school board campaign that money can possibly buy.
sentences.zh: 这是金钱所能买到的最好的地方校董会竞选。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, of course, when these well-financed campaigns, you know, wage their attacks, the other side fights back.
sentences.zh: 当然，当这些资金充足的竞选团队发动攻击时，另一方也会反击。

sentences.en: And so these anonymous attack sites start spouting up on the other side.
sentences.zh: 于是，匿名的攻击网站开始在另一方涌现。

sentences.en: And it all just ramps up very faSt.
sentences.zh: 一切都迅速升级。

sentences.en: And, Campbell, what is the criteria to get this Paul Martino funding?
sentences.zh: 坎贝尔，获得保罗·马蒂诺资助的标准是什么？

sentences.en: Is it really as simple as whether or not the candidate supports reopenings?
sentences.zh: 真的仅仅取决于候选人是否支持重新开放吗？

sentences.en: Well, here's where it gets fascinating.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是迷人的地方。

sentences.en: And the short answer is yes, that really does appear to be it.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是肯定的，看起来确实如此。

sentences.en: But, of course, as we've been talking about, as the school board fight has become polarized and politicized, we've seen the reopening battles evolve into something more symbolic.
sentences.zh: 但当然，正如我们一直在讨论的那样，随着校董会斗争变得两极分化和政治化，我们看到重新开放的争论演变成了更具象征意义的东西。

sentences.en: And so what you see is that often a candidate supporting reopenings is now synonymous with a candidate who opposes mask mandates or is running on an anti-CRT platform.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到的是，支持重新开放的候选人现在往往等同于反对口罩强制令或以反批判性种族理论（CRT）为纲领的候选人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These all kind of get linked.
sentences.zh: 这些都联系在一起了。

sentences.en: So there's often a kind of shared platform that unites the reopening candidates.
sentences.zh: 所以通常有一个联合纲领将支持重新开放的候选人团结在一起。

sentences.en: And it's not just about reopening.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是关于重新开放。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in Central Bucks, all of the candidates Martino ended up supporting ran on a platform against mask requirements, really parental choice, which is mask optional.
sentences.zh: 所以在中央巴克斯，马蒂诺最终支持的所有候选人都反对口罩要求，实际上是主张家长选择权，即口罩可选。

sentences.en: That was the party line.
sentences.zh: 那是他们的党纲。

sentences.en: And when I looked at other candidates that Martino was supporting in the Philly suburbs outside of Bucks, they were really emphasizing the same themes.
sentences.zh: 当我观察马蒂诺在巴克斯县以外的费城郊区支持的其他候选人时，他们确实在强调同样的主题。

sentences.en: But what's interesting is how Martino talks about his feelings on these other issues.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是马蒂诺如何谈论他在这些其他议题上的感受。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Mask mandates.
sentences.zh: 口罩强制令。

sentences.en: What's your thinking on mask mandates?
sentences.zh: 你对口罩强制令有什么看法？

sentences.en: If we need masks for in-person education, great.
sentences.zh: 如果我们需要口罩来进行面对面教学，那很好。

sentences.en: If your local administrator says that you don't need masks, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 如果你的地方行政人员说不需要口罩，那也没问题。

sentences.en: I don't have an opinion on the matter.
sentences.zh: 我对此没有意见。

sentences.en: I think the mask discussion has become completely overblown.
sentences.zh: 我认为关于口罩的讨论已经被完全夸大了。

sentences.en: It's some sort of weird litmus teSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一种奇怪的试金石。

sentences.en: Are you anti-science or are you not?
sentences.zh: 你是反科学还是不反？

sentences.en: Whereas I don't think that's what the key issue is.
sentences.zh: 而我不认为这是关键问题所在。

sentences.en: If the local school administrators and or local health directors say we don't need a mask because this metric, this metric, and this metric are where they are, great.
sentences.zh: 如果地方学校行政人员和/或地方卫生主管说我们不需要口罩，因为这个指标、那个指标和那个指标都在正常范围内，那很好。

sentences.en: If they say we do, no problem.
sentences.zh: 如果他们说我们做，没问题。

sentences.en: I'm not anti-mask.
sentences.zh: 我不是反口罩派。

sentences.en: I'm not pro-mask, though.
sentences.zh: 但我也不属于支持口罩派。

sentences.en: I think there is a group out there that is pro-mask.
sentences.zh: 我觉得外面确实有一群人是支持口罩的。

sentences.en: Like, I need to have a mask on no matter what I do at all times, even if the case counts are zero.
sentences.zh: 比如，无论我做什么，哪怕病例数为零，我也必须时刻戴着口罩。

sentences.en: And so I'm neither pro nor anti, and I think this has really become a complete red herring in the discussion.
sentences.zh: 所以我既不支持也不反对，我认为这在讨论中已经完全变成了一个转移视线的幌子。

sentences.en: Well, I see what you're saying, that, you know, the focus is in-person education, whatever it takes to get that, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我明白你的意思，就是说，重点是线下教育，为了实现这一点不惜一切代价，对吧？

sentences.en: Agnostic on what it takes, but that's what it takes.
sentences.zh: 对于实现它需要什么我不置可否，但这就是实现它所需要的代价。

sentences.en: The candidates you're bankrolling, particularly in the Philadelphia region, North Penn, Bucks, and Montgomery, are almost all anti-mask mandate.
sentences.zh: 你资助的候选人，特别是在费城地区、北宾州、巴克斯县和蒙哥马利县的那些，几乎全都反对口罩令。

sentences.en: So it's one thing to say that masks aren't important.
sentences.zh: 所以，说口罩不重要是一回事。

sentences.en: I mean, they're a distraction, but these are the candidates you're giving money to, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们是一种干扰，但这些就是你正在资助的候选人，对吧？

sentences.en: Again, I truly feel that this is the secondary issue.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我真心觉得这是次要问题。

sentences.en: There's a group of people on one side that want to be in person, and there's a group of people on the other side that are cautious to a fault.
sentences.zh: 一边有一群人希望进行线下教学，而另一边有一群人谨慎到了极点。

sentences.en: And I think that safety to a fault, cautious to a fault, has become the kind of primary thinking, as opposed to, this is a hard problem.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种谨慎到极点的安全观，已经成为了一种主要的思维方式，而不是去面对这是一个难题的事实。

sentences.en: What onus do we need to put back on us as administrators to solve the problem?
sentences.zh: 作为管理者，我们需要承担什么责任来解决这个问题？

sentences.en: And so I want to have people on our school boards who want to solve problems, not who want safety to a fault.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望我们的校董会里有那些想解决问题的人，而不是那些只追求极端安全的人。

sentences.en: That has really, I think, been the wrong kind of ideology to have.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实是一种错误的意识形态。

sentences.en: And that's the break between the two sides on this issue.
sentences.zh: 这就是在这个问题上双方的分歧所在。

sentences.en: I see what you're saying, but this is sort of the trick here, right?
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思，但这有点像是个圈套，对吧？

sentences.en: That you're talking about that you want a very practical, cold-eyed take on how can we get people back in schools.
sentences.zh: 你谈论的是你想要一种非常务实、冷静的视角，来看我们如何能让人们回到学校。

sentences.en: Because, you know, under modified quarantine, part of it's based on the fact that people are wearing masks, right?
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，在改良后的隔离政策下，部分依据是人们戴着口罩，对吧？

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, you know, this is not ideological.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这与意识形态无关。

sentences.en: Let's just get kids back in school.
sentences.zh: 让我们只是让孩子们回到学校上课吧。

sentences.en: The candidates you're bankrolling are both almost universally, at least in the Philadelphia region, strongly against mask mandates.
sentences.zh: 你资助的候选人几乎普遍都强烈反对口罩令，至少在费城地区是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, they all, you know, you see many, many flyers about get critical race theory out of our schools.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们都，你知道，你看到很多很多传单上写着把批判性种族理论赶出我们的学校。

sentences.en: Is it impossible to be against school closures and not be also against critical race theory and mask mandates and other things?
sentences.zh: 难道一个人既反对学校关闭，又不反对批判性种族理论和口罩令以及其他事情，是不可能的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, why are those things aligned?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为什么这些事情会被捆绑在一起？

sentences.en: That is absolutely the case.
sentences.zh: 事实确实如此。

sentences.en: And look, I can run you through some of the numbers, Campbell.
sentences.zh: 听着，坎贝尔，我可以带你过一遍数据。

sentences.en: About a third of our candidates, we estimate, are actually on the Democrat side of the fence, less so in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 我们估计，我们大约三分之一的候选人实际上是站在民主党阵营的，在费城的情况少一些。

sentences.en: I must admit that is a true statement that in Montgomery and Bucks County, it's turned out that the candidates we have backed have been more Republican than statewide.
sentences.zh: 我必须承认这是一个事实，在蒙哥马利县和巴克斯县，我们支持的候选人确实比全州范围内的更偏向共和党。

sentences.en: Statewide, statewide, though, looks like it's about 30, 35 percent are Democrats, and they have an eclectic set of views on those issues.
sentences.zh: 不过在全州范围内，看起来大约有30%到35%是民主党人，他们对这些问题有着兼容并蓄的看法。

sentences.en: Some of our groups are highly progressive groups in inner cities that are pro-CRT.
sentences.zh: 我们的一些团体是内城高度进步的团体，他们是支持批判性种族理论的。

sentences.en: We are not making a statement about those issues.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有就这些问题发表声明。

sentences.en: We're showing up to those districts that other people didn't pay attention to, saying, your schools need to be open because guess what?
sentences.zh: 我们出现在那些其他人没有关注的学区，告诉他们，你们的学校需要开放，因为你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: Your kids are falling even further behind.
sentences.zh: 你们的孩子正在进一步落后。

sentences.en: How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 我能帮你什么吗？

sentences.en: And so, no, I don't think that there needs to be a lockstep.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，我不认为需要步调一致。

sentences.en: You're anti-mask, you are anti-CRT, and you are blank.
sentences.zh: 你反口罩，你反批判性种族理论，你就是空白。

sentences.en: I don't think that needs to be the case at all.
sentences.zh: 我不认为非得那样不可。

sentences.en: And if it turns out that in Bucks and Montgomery County, it lined up that way more often than not, that is a coincidence as opposed to a design goal.
sentences.zh: 如果结果发现在巴克斯县和蒙哥马利县，情况大多如此，那也是巧合，而不是设计目标。

sentences.en: A coincidence as opposed to a design goal.
sentences.zh: 是巧合，而不是设计目标。

sentences.en: Yeah, and again, to a degree, this may be true in the sense that, as we've talked about, the reopening issue has always had this sort of natural conservative bent.
sentences.zh: 是的，再说一次，在某种程度上这可能是真的，正如我们所讨论的，重新开放的问题一直有一种天然的保守倾向。

sentences.en: And it's true that Martino's given funding to PACs that support some Democrats, including a PAC in Harrisburg called Blackwall PA,
sentences.zh: 而且确实，马蒂诺资助了一些支持民主党人的政治行动委员会，包括哈里斯堡一个叫“黑墙宾州”的委员会，

sentences.en: which says it fights against racism and justice and voter suppression.
sentences.zh: 该委员会声称它致力于反对种族主义、不公正和选民压制。

sentences.en: But even he says that only about a third of the candidates he's supporting are Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但即使是他也说，他支持的候选人中只有大约三分之一是民主党人。

sentences.en: And some surveys that news outlets in Pennsylvania have done have found the number is significantly lower than even that.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州的新闻媒体所做的一些调查发现，这个数字甚至比那还要低得多。

sentences.en: I mean, the candidates in Central Bucks who were funded by Martino's PAC were Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，中央巴克斯县那些由马蒂诺的政治行动委员会资助的候选人都是共和党人。

sentences.en: I reached out to PACs in other districts in Bucks County to see where their money was going, and the ones I found were backing almost all Republicans, too.
sentences.zh: 我联系了巴克斯县其他学区的政治行动委员会，想看看他们的钱流向了哪里，我发现的那些也几乎都在支持共和党人。

sentences.en: So whether it's a coincidence, who's to say?
sentences.zh: 所以这到底是巧合，谁说得准呢？

sentences.en: But I think the more interesting question is,
sentences.zh: 但我认为更有趣的问题是，

sentences.en: why is Paul Martino putting half a million dollars into school board races if all he cares about is reopening and the schools have reopened?
sentences.zh: 如果保罗·马蒂诺关心的只是重新开放，而学校已经重新开放了，他为什么还要在校董会竞选中投入五十万美元？

sentences.en: So you don't feel yourself aligned that way on those cultural issues?
sentences.zh: 所以你觉得自己在这些文化议题上并没有那样站队？

sentences.en: I mean, I know you've been, I think you described yourself in the Bucks County paper as a, quote, hardcore Republican.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我知道你曾经，我想你在巴克斯县的报纸上形容自己是一个“铁杆共和党人”。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But again, that is, you consider that completely divorced from the mission of this particular movement?
sentences.zh: 但再说一次，你认为这与这个特定运动的使命完全脱节吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对脱节。

sentences.en: And I get a lot of flack for this, but I can explain it to you quite simply.
sentences.zh: 我为此受到了很多抨击，但我可以很简单地向你解释。

sentences.en: I have donated to causes in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我过去曾为各种事业捐过款。

sentences.en: If I wanted to create an anti-CRT PAC, I would have created the anti-CRT PAC and we'd be on the phone talking about that.
sentences.zh: 如果我想创建一个反批判性种族理论的政治行动委员会，我早就创建了，我们现在就会在电话里谈论那个了。

sentences.en: I created Back to School because that was the issue that I thought was most important to my kids, maybe your kids, other kids throughout the state of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我创建“回到学校”是因为我认为这是对我孩子、可能对你的孩子、以及宾夕法尼亚州其他孩子来说最重要的问题。

sentences.en: We created it bipartisan.
sentences.zh: 我们是以两党合作的方式创建它的。

sentences.en: I've got four employees on staff.
sentences.zh: 我有四名员工。

sentences.en: Two of them are Democrats.
sentences.zh: 其中两个是民主党人。

sentences.en: Two of them are Republicans.
sentences.zh: 其中两个是共和党人。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't go and hire those people because I was really closetedly doing an anti-CRT PAC.
sentences.zh: 我雇佣这些人并不是因为我私下里在搞一个反批判性种族理论的政治行动委员会。

sentences.en: If I wanted to do an anti-CRT PAC, and maybe one day I will, I'll fund it and I'll come on your podcast and tell you why I did that.
sentences.zh: 如果我想搞一个反批判性种族理论的政治行动委员会，也许有一天我会这么做，我会资助它，然后我会上你的播客告诉你我为什么这么做。

sentences.en: I mean, the goal of this one is pretty clear, even though people think I got some other ulterior motive.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个组织的目标很明确，尽管人们认为我有什么不可告人的动机。

sentences.en: So, schools and Bucks have been open to some degree for a year and they're open this year.
sentences.zh: 所以，巴克斯县的学校在某种程度上已经开放了一年，今年也开放了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There was some talk, you know, about potential closures.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些关于可能关闭学校的讨论。

sentences.en: But it seems like the salience of the school closures is fading.
sentences.zh: 但看起来学校关闭问题的显著性正在减弱。

sentences.en: Do you have higher aspirations with this?
sentences.zh: 你对这个组织有更高的抱负吗？

sentences.en: Like, do you see further goals of keeping this going beyond school openings?
sentences.zh: 比如，你是否看到了在学校开放之外继续保持这一势头的进一步目标？

sentences.en: So, I did not.
sentences.zh: 所以，我没有。

sentences.en: Again, not the plan.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这不是计划。

sentences.en: It was make sure that the schools stay open.
sentences.zh: 计划是确保学校保持开放。

sentences.en: And so, that was why we started.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我们开始的原因。

sentences.en: But now that we've actually got a statewide, we backed PACs in, I think, 25 of the 64 counties.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们实际上已经有了全州范围的影响力，我想我们在64个县中的25个县支持了政治行动委员会。

sentences.en: We got submissions from 200 PACs across the entire Commonwealth.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了全州200个政治行动委员会的申请。

sentences.en: What do we do next?
sentences.zh: 接下来我们做什么？

sentences.en: We almost by accident built a completely bottom-up, grassroots, parents-based organization in six months.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎是偶然地在六个月内建立了一个完全自下而上、草根的、以家长为基础的组织。

sentences.en: That is not an easy thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: So, no, I don't know what we're going to do next.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，我不知道我们接下来要做什么。

sentences.en: But, Campbell, I promise you there will be something next because this is a very interesting asset we've built.
sentences.zh: 但是，坎贝尔，我向你保证接下来会有所行动，因为我们建立了一个非常有趣的资产。

sentences.en: We need to figure out how to empower these parents forward.
sentences.zh: 我们需要弄清楚如何赋予这些家长权力，让他们继续前进。

sentences.en: And I don't know what that answer is yet.
sentences.zh: 我还不知道那个答案是什么。

sentences.en: Happy to come on your podcast next time when I do know.
sentences.zh: 等我知道的时候，很高兴下次再上你的播客。

sentences.en: So, Paul is saying he does have further political aspirations for this movement he's helped start in finance.
sentences.zh: 所以，保罗说他确实对他帮助发起和资助的这场运动有进一步的政治抱负。

sentences.en: He just doesn't know what those are yet.
sentences.zh: 他只是还不知道那些抱负是什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's what he's saying.
sentences.zh: 是的，他就是这么说的。

sentences.en: And I kept trying.
sentences.zh: 我一直在追问。

sentences.en: Where are you in discussions of where to take this next?
sentences.zh: 在讨论下一步该怎么走时，你处于什么阶段？

sentences.en: Oh, we got a lot of ideas.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们有很多想法。

sentences.en: So, what are some of your ideas?
sentences.zh: 那么，你的一些想法是什么？

sentences.en: So, Campbell, sorry, I'm going to have to politely decline on that one.
sentences.zh: 所以，坎贝尔，抱歉，我不得不礼貌地拒绝回答这个问题。

sentences.en: I'm happy to get a hold of you soon enough.
sentences.zh: 我很快就会联系你的。

sentences.en: Do have a lot of ideas, though.
sentences.zh: 不过确实有很多想法。

sentences.en: And, again, I'm not trying to be cute.
sentences.zh: 而且，再说一次，我不是在装模作样。

sentences.en: I'll tell it to you as the venture capitalist in me.
sentences.zh: 我以我作为风险投资人的身份告诉你。

sentences.en: The companies I've started that have been successful have usually been successful when you go swim in the right pond.
sentences.zh: 我创办的那些成功的公司，通常都是在你选对了池塘游泳时才成功的。

sentences.en: You don't really know how to swim, but you know you're in the right pond.
sentences.zh: 你并不真正知道怎么游泳，但你知道你在正确的池塘里。

sentences.en: You know you've got the right idea.
sentences.zh: 你知道你有正确的想法。

sentences.en: And so, it turned out, I think, this is the happy accident here as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，事实证明，我认为这也是一个幸运的意外。

sentences.en: It turned out that activating a grassroots set of parents would be a potentially new powerful political force.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，激活一群草根家长可能成为一股潜在的新兴强大政治力量。

sentences.en: I had no idea that that was going to be the case.
sentences.zh: 我完全没想到会是这样。

sentences.en: And so, now I've got to go play the game the way I do as a startup.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在我必须像经营初创公司那样去玩这场游戏。

sentences.en: I now have this interesting asset.
sentences.zh: 我现在拥有了这个有趣的资产。

sentences.en: What would be a great way to deploy that?
sentences.zh: 什么才是部署它的好方法？

sentences.en: And that's the question I'm now working with.
sentences.zh: 这就是我现在正在研究的问题。

sentences.en: And that's, quite frankly, how we've scaled startups in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这就是我们过去扩大初创公司规模的方式。

sentences.en: And I feel bizarrely qualified to try and answer this question.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己非常有资格去尝试回答这个问题。

sentences.en: And you'll hear from us soon.
sentences.zh: 你很快就会收到我们的消息。

sentences.en: But the basic mission that I'm hearing, in other words, the thing that keeps it going beyond school closures, is greater parental power in schools?
sentences.zh: 但我听到的基本使命，换句话说，就是让它在学校关闭之外继续存在的东西，是家长在学校中拥有更大的权力？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: I think the core of this is that we woke up parents who were apolitical in the past to that the school boards were very fundamentally important to their family because it was their kid's education.
sentences.zh: 我认为其核心在于，我们唤醒了过去不关心政治的家长，让他们意识到校董会对他们的家庭至关重要，因为这关系到他们孩子的教育。

sentences.en: And so, certainly, that would then mean other things like curriculum, et cetera, downstream.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，这意味着后续会有其他事情，比如课程设置等等。

sentences.en: But having a network of activated previously apolitical parents, that's a pretty interesting group of people who didn't used to show up.
sentences.zh: 但拥有一个由以前不关心政治的家长组成的活跃网络，那是一群非常有趣的、以前从不露面的人。

sentences.en: These aren't your every two-year voters.
sentences.zh: 这些人不是你每两年见一次的选民。

sentences.en: These aren't people who probably even knew there were odd-year elections.
sentences.zh: 这些人甚至可能都不知道还有奇数年的选举。

sentences.en: And it's exciting to see those kinds of people be active for the first time.
sentences.zh: 看到这些人第一次变得活跃起来，真是令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Okay, well, this is where you started your reporting, right?
sentences.zh: 好的，好吧，这就是你开始报道的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: This idea that in an important political state like Pennsylvania, a swing state, if you can really find a way to mobilize a large group of voters or potential voters,
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，在像宾夕法尼亚州这样一个重要的政治州，一个摇摆州，如果你真的能找到一种方法动员一大群选民或潜在选民，

sentences.en: that can make a very big difference at both the local and the national level.
sentences.zh: 那可以在地方和国家层面产生非常大的影响。

sentences.en: And to be honest, it can make or break a presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 老实说，它甚至可以决定总统竞选的成败。

sentences.en: And what I hear Paul saying is, I found those voters.
sentences.zh: 我听到保罗说的是，我找到了那些选民。

sentences.en: And it turns out that what motivates them is schools.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，激励他们的是学校。

sentences.en: Yeah, so the kind of essential question here, the one that we've been kind of circling around this whole conversation is,
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这里的一个核心问题，也就是我们在整个谈话中一直在绕着谈的问题是，

sentences.en: is the whole reopening issue a Republican Trojan horse?
sentences.zh: 整个重新开放的问题是一个共和党的“特洛伊木马”吗？

sentences.en: Have people like Martino seized on genuine concerns that parents have about school closures and used that to build a political movement that's about all this other stuff?
sentences.zh: 像马蒂诺这样的人是否抓住了家长对学校关闭的真正担忧，并利用这一点建立了一个涉及所有其他事情的政治运动？

sentences.en: And could it become a playbook for winning all kinds of elections, whether that's across Bucks County, across the state of Pennsylvania, even across the country?
sentences.zh: 它是否会成为赢得各种选举的剧本，无论是在巴克斯县、宾夕法尼亚州全州，甚至是全国？

sentences.en: But then meanwhile, as we've talked about, the schools have real issues that need addressing,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，正如我们所讨论的，学校确实有需要解决的问题，

sentences.en: like practical issues that some people like John Gamble and some of the teachers and staff are worried are getting totally overshadowed
sentences.zh: 比如像约翰·甘布尔和一些老师及员工所担心的那些实际问题，他们担心这些问题被完全掩盖了，

sentences.en: by these battles over COVID policy and cultural stuff.
sentences.zh: 被这些关于新冠政策和文化议题的争斗所掩盖。

sentences.en: So I wanted to know what Martino thought about these other school issues that don't lend themselves so readily to politics.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想知道马蒂诺对这些不那么容易政治化的其他学校问题有什么看法。

sentences.en: So at the same time that there is, I think, a very valid debate over the COVID mitigation procedures,
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为在对新冠缓解措施进行非常有效的辩论的同时，

sentences.en: you know, in Central Bucks as well as districts nationwide, I mean, there are a lot of issues, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，在中央巴克斯县以及全国各地的学区，我的意思是，有很多问题，对吧？

sentences.en: There's very severe staffing shortages.
sentences.zh: 存在非常严重的员工短缺。

sentences.en: You can't get substitutes.
sentences.zh: 你找不到代课老师。

sentences.en: There are very few education aides per student to the degree that they want them.
sentences.zh: 每个学生的教育辅助人员少得可怜，远达不到他们想要的程度。

sentences.en: Do you see those as big issues too?
sentences.zh: 你认为这些也是大问题吗？

sentences.en: Are those part of what your movement is addressing?
sentences.zh: 这些是你运动正在解决的一部分吗？

sentences.en: So we are a single issue pack focused exclusively on the schools being open.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个单一议题的政治行动委员会，专门专注于学校开放。

sentences.en: Those issues related to staffing levels are, of course, related to our primary purpose.
sentences.zh: 那些与人员配备水平相关的问题，当然与我们的主要目的有关。

sentences.en: But we are not making statements about curriculum.
sentences.zh: 但我们没有就课程设置发表声明。

sentences.en: We're not getting involved in the school bus shortage.
sentences.zh: 我们没有参与校车短缺的问题。

sentences.en: That's not the kind of stuff that we're focused on.
sentences.zh: 那不是我们关注的事情。

sentences.en: To the extent they make it impossible to have in-person education, those are things we focused on.
sentences.zh: 只要它们导致无法进行线下教育，那就是我们关注的事情。

sentences.en: The staff shortages in particular over in the Pittsburgh districts that led to a delayed opening here in 2021, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，匹兹堡学区的人员短缺导致了2021年的延迟开学。

sentences.en: We paid a lot of attention to that, supported a lot of groups in the Pittsburgh and Allegheny County areas that really said, look, enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 我们对此非常关注，并支持了匹兹堡和阿勒格尼县地区的许多团体，他们真正表达了“够了，受够了”的心声。

sentences.en: You not only weren't open last year, we got a whole year to get ready for this.
sentences.zh: 你们去年不仅没有开放，我们还有整整一年的时间来为此做准备。

sentences.en: Let's solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 让我们解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Is it frustrating?
sentences.zh: 这令人沮丧吗？

sentences.en: I mean, we talked a little bit about the challenges that schools are facing that are not locked down, not even COVID-related, you know, staffing shortages.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们稍微谈到了学校面临的挑战，这些学校并没有封锁，甚至与新冠疫情无关，你知道，比如人员短缺。

sentences.en: Is it frustrating that as someone who wants good schools for your kids and who has the will to spend a lot of money on it,
sentences.zh: 作为一个希望孩子能上好学校，并且愿意为此投入大量资金的人，

sentences.en: that the only outlet to do that that you see right now is funding school board races?
sentences.zh: 发现目前唯一能做的途径就是资助校董会竞选，这难道不令人沮丧吗？

sentences.en: Is it frustrating that there are these resources and it's hard to figure out a way to use them to make schools better outside of politics?
sentences.zh: 明明有这些资源，却很难找到一种方法在政治之外利用它们来改善学校，这不令人沮丧吗？

sentences.en: We have a very blunt instrument, which is every two years, about half the school board seats are up.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个非常生硬的工具，那就是每两年，大约一半的校董会席位会进行改选。

sentences.en: And it turns out in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, school boards are remarkably powerful.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在宾夕法尼亚州，校董会的权力非常大。

sentences.en: And so like a presidential election in the U.S., it's a blunt instrument.
sentences.zh: 所以就像美国的总统选举一样，这是一个生硬的工具。

sentences.en: And every couple of years, you get to show up.
sentences.zh: 每隔几年，你就有机会参与其中。

sentences.en: I'd be all for a more direct version of democracy where there could be oversight, balance, checks, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 我完全支持一种更直接的民主形式，在那里可以有监督、制衡等等。

sentences.en: But right now, this is what we got.
sentences.zh: 但目前，这就是我们所拥有的。

sentences.en: We got school boards every two years.
sentences.zh: 我们每两年就有一次校董会选举。

sentences.en: So Martino's response is the way school boards work and the way schools work, we can't just directly fund the schools.
sentences.zh: 所以马蒂诺的回应是，鉴于校董会和学校的运作方式，我们不能直接资助学校。

sentences.en: Private citizens can't just give them the resources that they need.
sentences.zh: 普通公民无法直接提供他们所需的资源。

sentences.en: And in terms of the mental health issues that the students are battling, the thing that Betsy Coyne was talking about, the behavioral issues, that, he would say,
sentences.zh: 至于学生们正在应对的心理健康问题，就是贝齐·科因所谈论的那些行为问题，他会说，

sentences.en: is exactly what motivated him to create this single issue pack.
sentences.zh: 这正是促使他创建这个单一议题政治行动委员会的原因。

sentences.en: That the damage done to kids by closing schools was so great that anyone involved should be out of their seat on a board.
sentences.zh: 因为关闭学校对孩子们造成的伤害太大了，任何参与其中的人都应该被赶下董事会席位。

sentences.en: And right now, all that should matter is that a candidate wouldn't let that happen again.
sentences.zh: 而现在，唯一重要的事情就是候选人不会让这种情况再次发生。

sentences.en: Again, though, the central question is, when you're spending hundreds of thousands of dollars on school board candidates and your litmus test is one issue,
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，核心问题是，当你花费数十万美元支持校董会候选人，而你的试金石只有一个议题时，

sentences.en: what else is that money supporting?
sentences.zh: 这笔钱还在支持什么呢？

sentences.en: Who is that money supporting when you focus on just that one issue?
sentences.zh: 当你只关注那一个议题时，这笔钱到底在支持谁？

sentences.en: I mean, one of the candidates in central box who got Martino's PAC support, she was at one meeting and was talking about demonic adults brainwashing and recruiting children.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，中央巴克斯的一位候选人获得了马蒂诺政治行动委员会的支持，她在一次会议上谈到了恶魔般的成年人洗脑和招募儿童。

sentences.en: But she had the right stance on reopening, so she got the backing.
sentences.zh: 但她在重新开放学校的问题上立场正确，所以她得到了支持。

sentences.en: It's complicated.
sentences.zh: 这很复杂。

sentences.en: So now you have this slate across the Commonwealth of candidates moving on to other fights in the future.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你在全州范围内拥有了一批候选人，他们正准备投入未来的其他斗争中。

sentences.en: Do you see this as a source of Republican strength in future elections?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是共和党在未来选举中力量的源泉吗？

sentences.en: I don't think I've ever thought about that that way.
sentences.zh: 我想我从来没有那样想过。

sentences.en: But given that there are more Republicans than Democrats, you're going to have to imagine that the issues are going to be more right aligned in the future.
sentences.zh: 但考虑到共和党人比民主党人多，你不得不想象未来的议题会更偏向右翼。

sentences.en: I would love it if we could get to a spot where we didn't have to pick left-right issues with a statewide bipartisan group.
sentences.zh: 如果能达到一个不需要通过全州两党团体来选择左右翼议题的境地，我会很高兴。

sentences.en: Again, if I wanted to start a Republican PAC, I'd go start a Republican PAC.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，如果我想成立一个共和党政治行动委员会，我早就去成立了。

sentences.en: I've got this unique amalgam of people who wouldn't otherwise be on the same team.
sentences.zh: 我拥有的是一群独特的组合，他们本来不会在同一个团队里。

sentences.en: It seems like there's something good we can do with that.
sentences.zh: 似乎我们可以利用这一点做些好事。

sentences.en: And if all it does is now devolve into a single Republican issue, haven't I squandered an opportunity, Campbell?
sentences.zh: 如果这一切最终演变成一个单一的共和党议题，那我岂不是浪费了一个机会，坎贝尔？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: I think that depends on how you view the opportunity because a Republican PAC would get the same old Republican activists where getting apolitical people involved with pursuing Republican goals,
sentences.zh: 我认为这取决于你如何看待这个机会，因为共和党政治行动委员会只会吸引那些老派的共和党活动家，而让非政治人士参与追求共和党的目标，

sentences.en: even if it is Republican PAC, that seems like a pretty big victory politically.
sentences.zh: 即使它是共和党政治行动委员会，这在政治上似乎也是一个相当大的胜利。

sentences.en: As I said, and I got to tell you, that's more accident than genius, right?
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我得告诉你，这更多是偶然而非天才之举，对吧？

sentences.en: And so we've got that group of people, apolitical people who decided that their kid's education was time for them to step up.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有了那群人，那些决定为了孩子的教育而挺身而出的非政治人士。

sentences.en: And again, turning that just into a recruiting zone for Republican candidates strikes me as a misuse of the asset.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，仅仅把这变成共和党候选人的招募区，在我看来是对这种资产的滥用。

sentences.en: But the actual use of the asset is still under discussion at the moment.
sentences.zh: 但目前关于如何实际使用这种资产还在讨论中。

sentences.en: That's what we've got to figure out.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们需要弄清楚的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, we've got a big election on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，周二我们有一场重要的选举。

sentences.en: We've got a lot of races to win.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多场竞选要赢。

sentences.en: And we now know that there's probably going to be life after this.
sentences.zh: 而且我们现在知道，在这之后可能还会有生活。

sentences.en: And it's my job to figure that out.
sentences.zh: 而我的工作就是弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: Mr. Martino, I appreciate you giving me a few minutes of your time.
sentences.zh: 马蒂诺先生，感谢您抽出几分钟时间。

sentences.en: Very good, Campbell.
sentences.zh: 非常好，坎贝尔。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, November 2nd, Republicans won three out of the five open seats in the Central Bucks School Board elections, cementing their control of the board.
sentences.zh: 11月2日星期二，共和党人在中央巴克斯校董会选举中赢得了五个空缺席位中的三个，巩固了他们对董事会的控制。

sentences.en: And across Bucks County, Republicans won race after race for local office,
sentences.zh: 在整个巴克斯县，共和党人在地方公职竞选中连战连捷，

sentences.en: an outcome that many observers attributed to the turnout of voters motivated by the races for school board.
sentences.zh: 许多观察家将这一结果归因于受校董会竞选激励而投票的选民投票率。

sentences.en: On the same night, the Republican candidate for governor of Virginia, Glenn Youngkin,
sentences.zh: 就在同一晚，弗吉尼亚州共和党州长候选人格伦·扬金，

sentences.en: won his race by making schools and what he called the empowerment of parents central to his campaign.
sentences.zh: 通过将学校以及他所谓的“赋权家长”作为竞选核心，赢得了选举。

sentences.en: We proved in Virginia that the people can stand up and vote for someone who stands up for us.
sentences.zh: 我们在弗吉尼亚州证明了，人民可以站出来，投票给支持我们的人。

sentences.en: People are attending the school board.
sentences.zh: 人们正在参加校董会会议。

sentences.en: Last week, the Central Bucks School Board met for the first time since the election.
sentences.zh: 上周，中央巴克斯校董会召开了选举以来的第一次会议。

sentences.en: Oh, diversity, education.
sentences.zh: 哦，多元化，教育。

sentences.en: Oh, transgender.
sentences.zh: 哦，跨性别者。

sentences.en: He has the right to go into the woman's bathroom and rape her.
sentences.zh: 他有权进入女厕所并强奸她。

sentences.en: Then they send him, send the student to another school.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把他，把那个学生送到另一所学校。

sentences.en: That's enough.
sentences.zh: 够了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: And we need to address it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要解决这个问题。

sentences.en: You need to stop.
sentences.zh: 你需要停止。

sentences.en: I'm going to have to have you removed if you cannot be respectful.
sentences.zh: 如果你不能保持尊重，我将不得不请你离开。

sentences.en: He is allowed to...
sentences.zh: 他被允许……

sentences.en: I'm a little shaken right now with everything that's just taken place.
sentences.zh: 刚才发生的一切让我有点震惊。

sentences.en: I came here to actually say thank you.
sentences.zh: 我来这里其实是为了说声谢谢。

sentences.en: But, my God, where did I move?
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，我搬到哪里来了？

sentences.en: Where did I move?
sentences.zh: 我搬到哪里来了？

sentences.en: This is horrendous.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: I'm going to raise my children here.
sentences.zh: 我打算在这里抚养我的孩子。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 这是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Times reports that federal regulators plan to authorize booster shots of Pfizer-BioNTech's COVID-19 vaccine for all adults as early as today.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，联邦监管机构计划最早于今天授权所有成年人接种辉瑞-生物科技公司新冠疫苗的加强针。

sentences.en: That would expand the number of Americans eligible for a third shot by tens of millions and begin making a booster shot a standard part of vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 这将使有资格接种第三针的美国人数量增加数千万，并开始使加强针成为疫苗接种的标准部分。

sentences.en: Because regulators allow Americans to mix and match boosters, every adult could get a Pfizer booster, no matter which original vaccine they used.
sentences.zh: 由于监管机构允许美国人混合接种加强针，无论他们最初接种的是哪种疫苗，每位成年人都可以接种辉瑞加强针。

sentences.en: Moderna is expected to seek a similar authorization for its booster in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 预计莫德纳公司将在未来几周内为其加强针寻求类似的授权。

sentences.zh: 由丽莎·托宾编辑。

sentences.zh: 包含马里昂·洛萨诺、罗谢尔·邦贾、科里·施雷佩尔和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正准备迎接假期客人的到来。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
